segments.text: A college student in the Literature Department, majoring in Psychology. He will become a junior in the spring, and it will be two years until he joins society. Since he doesn't have any real ambitions, he tends to skip his college lectures, and staggers through each day.

Under normal circumstances, he would have been held back, but he's learned that this could be remedied if he attended the Seminar Camp. He then "participated" by becoming a member of this seminar he'd never heard of before.

However, Izumi, the professor in charge of the Seminar Lodge, had plans for him. She had made sure that he knew no one else there so that he could become the test subject for the Curé Syndrome counter experiment.
(From PSP TIPS)

Izumi and Kurumi's father, the world-famous authority on genetic engineering. A man who participated in the Human Genome Project, a project with the goal to clarify the whole particulars of humans by analyzing the genomes they possessed. He made striking results on said project.
(Never7)
He used cloning techniques at a time where cloning was still illegal to create Kurumi's clone ― Haruka.
(Ever17)

He met Yubiseiharukana by chance when she was suffering from a severe heart disease and was on the verge of despair, and perhaps because he has two daughters close to her age, they eventually developed a father-daughter relationship. He convinced You, who had only a short time left to live, to give birth to a clone, and he offered to fully support her.
He has a deep knowledge of both Curé Syndrome and the Curé Virus.
(From the Never7/Ever17 PSP-exclusive TIPS)

Yuka's classmate from middle school. He was her first love, and is described as being kind in a nonchalant manner, having a slightly affected way of speaking, and above all, a strong, characteristic will.
He died during a school field trip when he gave up his life to save Yuka and her friends from a fire that had broken out in their hotel.

According to Yuka and Saki, it seems that Makoto's attitude greatly resembles the boy's. Makoto's prejudice towards him, in addition to jealousy, might be due to his congeneric hatred; his disdain for how uncanny the resemblance is.

The night of the field trip, he told Yuka the myth of Gemini — The mortal older brother who died, outlived by his younger brother. The immortal younger brother who could never die. Even though they were similar, they followed different destinies. Yuka became captured by an infinite loop, where she herself wasn't even able to die, her destiny overlapping with Makoto's...
(Edited from PSP TIPS)
(Based off the main heroine from the KID Visual Novel Memories Off.)

An innocent little girl who came to the island with her family to sightsee. By chance, she picked up the bell that Yuka threw away, but gave it back to Yuka in exchange for the fat cat mascot character keychain. It seems that she'll treasure the keychain for a long time.
(Edited from PSP TIPS)

A fisherman who supposedly lives near Luna Beach. He tries touching Izumi’s rear whenever he’s given an opportunity. Such an enviable... I mean, shameless, act garners Izumi's anger. Despite that, she doesn’t actually hate him. This development gives him the air of a "cheerful, yet slightly perverted old man".
Still, he should be more cautious. Most women aren’t as tolerant. Were he to behave this intimate towards them, he might be charged with sexual harassment.
(From PSP TIPS)
A boy from Morino Kurumi's past who was a grade higher than her. He was friends with her until he discovered her secret.
Birthday: August 3, 1998 (Leo)
Birthstone: Peridot
Likes: Miniskirts, family, alcohol
Dislikes: Fermented soybeans
Special Skills: Pictures, sports, heavy drinking, making murderous cooking
Family: Mother, father, younger brother, grandfather, grandmother, great-grandfather (lives away)

An upcoming junior who goes to the same college as Makoto. She serves as the group leader in the current Seminar Lodge, given that her cheerful and optimistic attitude makes her an ideal choice. Despite her friendly and outgoing personality, her tendency to wander around drunk has tainted her reputation, along with her disastrous cooking. Still, she's quite easy to get along with thanks to her kindness and good social skills.

In middle school, she met her first love, a male classmate whom she had never confessed her feelings for. Even five years after his death, she still mourns his death and can't break free of those bitter memories she has for him. She tries her best to hide these emotions from others, but after meeting Makoto at the camp and discovering how his speech and conduct resembles the boy's, her feelings become conflicted.
(From PSP TIPS)
Likes: Water, things she's seeing for the first time, parents
Dislikes: Tobacco, being looked at with pitiful eyes, eggs, milk
Special skills: Studying in school, private activities, sports that don't require stamina, taciturnity
Family: Mother, father
She is voiced by Matsuoka Yuki.
Birthday: November 7, 1998 (Scorpio)
Birthstone: Topaz
Likes: Nature, animals, herself
Dislikes: Things that trample down nature, parents, fast vehicles
Special Skills: Studying, having a contrarian attitude, being affectionate to animals, swearing and abusive language
Family: Mother, father, grandmother

A rich girl who goes to the top-class K University, she is currently relaxing in her summer house during her exams break, which is right next to the lodge that Makoto's group is staying at. A former classmate of Yuka's from middle school,
her class suspected that she destroyed The Magician's Portrait, a picture that Yuka drew. Since then, she's been slightly wary of other humans.

Ever since the incident, she hasn't shown her original self to anyone since then except for animals because she doesn't have to speak to them. However, this started to change when she came into contact with Makoto's group. She's resentful towards Haruka, who is a clone, as a result of regret and fear she felt from when she was a child, when her mother forced her to injure a clone girl whom Saki had been friends with.
(From PSP TIPS)
Likes: Tons of things! (Onii-chan, the occult, etc...)
Dislikes: Carrots, green peppers, onions.
Special Skills: Origami, simple cooking, always staying energetic, Kurminese
Family: Mother, father, older sister.
Likes: Detectives, conjecture, ladies' bikes
Dislikes: Gen-san, the local fisherman (for groping her butt)
Special Skills: Cooking, swimming, being a natural airhead, traffic violation
Family: Mother, father, younger sister
Birthday: January 11, 1999 (Capricornus)
Birthstone: Garnet
Blood Type: A+
Likes: Cute girls.
Dislikes: Men.
Special Skills: Sports popular with girls, driving his Ferarro, gaudy words, having a distinguished manner, sleeptalking.
Family: Mother, father, grandfather.
